error_reason: The Planner hallucinated that the text on the City University of New York (CUNY) website confirmed Brooklyn College is part of the State University of New York (SUNY). This is the decisive error because interpreting a cuny.edu page as proof of SUNY membership leads directly to the incorrect final answer, ignoring the explicit URL and page headers identifying the institution as part of CUNY.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner explicitly states that the page states Brooklyn College is within 'New York's public university system, confirming its place within SUNY,' while simultaneously acknowledging the URL is 'cuny.edu'. Since CUNY (City University of New York) is a distinct system from SUNY (State University of New York), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the text on the cuny.edu page to support a SUNY conclusion, leading to the wrong final answer.
hypotheses.check: Verify the content of the page opened at Step 10 (https://www.cuny.edu/schools/brooklyn-college/) to confirm if it mentions SUNY or if the Planner's assertion that the text confirms SUNY membership is factually incorrect given the domain and the nature of CUNY.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 11 explicitly claims the content of the Step 10 page (cuny.edu) confirms Brooklyn College is part of SUNY ('confirming its place within SUNY'). However, Step 10 shows the domain is cuny.edu and the page header identifies it as part of the 'City University of New York'. SUNY and CUNY are distinct systems; the text on a cuny.edu page cannot logically confirm membership in SUNY without explicit contradictory text, which is absent. The Planner hallucinated the presence of a SUNY confirmation on a CUNY website.

preconditions.condition: The text on the opened page (https://www.cuny.edu/schools/brooklyn-college/) explicitly states that Brooklyn College is 'within New York's public university system' and confirms its place within SUNY.
preconditions.evidence: Step 10 shows the page title 'Brooklyn College – The City University of New York' and URL cuny.edu. The visible text says 'Brooklyn College is an innovative liberal arts institution...'. It does not contain the phrase 'confirming its place within SUNY'.

postconditions.condition: Brooklyn College is part of The State University of New York (SUNY).
postconditions.evidence: Step 10 evidence and general knowledge indicate Brooklyn College is part of CUNY (City University of New York), evidenced by the URL cuny.edu and the page header 'The City University of New York'. SUNY is a separate system from CUNY.
